title: 瑠璃色の夜会と、失われた楽園の残照
author: 蘭 マリア

en.title: The Lapis Lazuli Soirée and the Afterglow of a Lost Paradise
en.premise: Seraphina, the daughter of a prestigious noble house, discovers an ancient automaton wandering the court's secret garden, its memories lost to time. The legends the doll whispers of a 'Mirror Village' that vanished from the map overnight hold the key to uncovering a cruel lie upon which the Empire's prosperity is built. Amidst the splendor of a ballroom that is but a battlefield in disguise, Seraphina finds herself drawn to a lonely young nobleman—a survivor of that village—as together they venture toward a forbidden truth.

zh.title: 瑠璃色的夜会与失落乐园的残照
zh.premise: 名门贵族之女塞拉菲娜，在宫廷的秘密花园中邂逅了一个失去记忆、徘徊不定的古老自动人偶（人工智能）。人偶口中那个“一夜之间从地图上消失的镜之村”的传说，竟成了揭开支撑帝国繁荣之残酷谎言的关键。在名为豪华舞会、实则为战场的社交圈中，塞拉菲娜与一名身为村庄幸存者的孤独青年贵族彼此吸引，两人共同踏入了禁忌的真相之中。
